## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Dunhuang Vinaya manual on practical *bhikṣu* decorum, organised by topical "gates" (隨門 *suímén* "following the gates"). 宗四分 indicates allegiance to the Sìfēn (Dharmaguptaka) Vinaya tradition.

**Abstract**

The text is a working Dunhuang monastic *wēiyí* (decorum) handbook, providing practical behavioural guidance for monks following the *Sìfēn lǜ* tradition. Together with the parallel Dunhuang fragments ([KR6k0133](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0133)–0142), the text documents the practical Vinaya life at Dunhuang in the late-Tang period.
